feed.title: Verilay Patchmap: Activation and licensing
feed.subtitle: Known problems and monthly security updates for Windows, from Verilay Patchmap. Not affiliated with Microsoft.

entry.title: Fix available: Activation and licensing commands fail with 0x80041008
entry.summary: Activation, KMS configuration or product key commands (for example slmgr) can fail with error 0x80041008, especially with automated licensing tools. Reported fixed by an out-of-band update on 13 Nov 2026. Server packages are in the Microsoft Update Catalog only. Check Microsoft's KB page for your version. Affects: Windows 11 24H2, Windows 11 25H2, Windows 11 26H2, Windows Server 2022, Windows Server 2025. Source: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/servicing/os/windows-11/2026/11/kb5131087-windows-11-23h2-security-update. From Patchmap (news and vendor reports).
